definitions.explanation: A dense forest found in areas of heavy rainfall, characterized by tall trees and rich biodiversity.

examples.japanese: {熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん}を{守|まも}る。
{雨林|うりん}には{多|おお}くの{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}が{生息|せいそく}している。
examples.english: Many animals and plants live in the rainforest.

examples.japanese: {雨林|うりん}の{伐採|ばっさい}が{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えている。
examples.english: Deforestation of rainforests is contributing to global warming.

notes:
USAGE:
{雨林|うりん} most commonly appears in the compound {熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん} (tropical rainforest). It can also be used on its own to refer to any type of rainforest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん} (tropical rainforest)
- {雨林|うりん}の{破壊|はかい} (destruction of rainforests)
- {雨林|うりん}{地帯|ちたい} (rainforest zone)
